title: Setting write request
description: PUT /settings/{name}. Carries contract_version and call_id in the body like every write (the Idempotency-Key header is gone). The add-on decodes it strictly. Request identity: identity/setting.json.

contract_version.description: The wire contract major both ends speak. Contract 2: equality-checked, a mismatch is refused with CONTRACT_VERSION_MISMATCH.

value.description: A value the target offers right now, or empty.
